name: asheshgoplani/agent-deck

hlido_opinion.headline: agent-deck is an individual developer's agent dashboard or control panel project — the 'deck' metaphor (a control deck) is evocative, but the surface is GitHub-only and early stage.
hlido_opinion.body: agent-deck by asheshgoplani appears to be a dashboard or control-panel project for managing AI agents — a 'deck' in the nautical/control sense, giving a single-pane view over multiple agents or agent runs. This concept aligns with a real need: as agent systems scale, operators need a unified interface to monitor, configure, and interact with multiple agents. However, the GitHub-only surface at review time means this is either a personal experiment or a very early product that has not reached public-launch readiness. The individual developer origin and absence of any product page make evaluation difficult. Worth monitoring if a product site or documentation appears.
